Technical training · Martigny, Switzerland

Generator Electrical
Diagnostic Tests

Turn generator test results into maintenance decisions you can explain and defend. Practical training for large turbo-generators and hydro-generators, built around diagnostic methods, measurement limitations and field cases.

The training is aimed at asset engineers, asset managers and other professionals responsible for rotating electrical machines. Some technical background is expected.

VenueMartigny, Switzerland
Early-bird price · until 20 January 2027CHF 850From 21 January to 10 February 2027: CHF 980
Designed for real decisions

Move beyond pass or fail

Learn how to select the right test, understand its limitations, interpret trends and combine evidence into a defensible assessment of machine condition.

01

Online diagnosis

Partial discharge, rotor flux, RSO, shaft voltage and bearing-current monitoring.

02

Stator diagnostics

IR and PI, HV testing, EL-CID, winding resistance, off-line PD, tan delta and wedge assessment.

03

Rotor diagnostics

Off-line RSO, rotor insulation assessment, voltage-drop testing and fault localisation.

Complimentary optional session

Online monitoring overview and live demonstration

A practical half-day introduction to continuous Partial Discharge, Rotor Flux and Shaft Voltage monitoring, including live hardware and software demonstrations.
